newsitem.title: FRANCE: French, Westerners held hostage on Nigeria rig.
newsitem.headline: French, Westerners held hostage on Nigeria rig.

text.p: Some 20 Westerners, including 16 French nationals, have been taken hostage by a local tribe on an oil platform off Nigeria, the French Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.
A ministry spokesman told Reuters that the hostages were employees of the French company ETPM. The rig was situated on a marshy stretch of land near the coast in the region of Houari, he said.
"Our embassy mobilised immediately and is in contact with local authorities and the company," the spokesman said.
There were no more immediate details of the hostage-taking or of the nationalities of those held.
Local tribes have seized foreign workers in similar raids in the past, chiefly to demand ransoms.
